items.statement: Every retained R- and S-forming transition-state candidate is explicitly identified and validated as a first-order saddle with the intended bond-forming mode and path connectivity.
items.expected: Per-candidate records show charge/multiplicity, exactly one intended imaginary mode with its frequency value, and bidirectional connectivity evidence; rejected candidates are identified with reasons.

items.statement: The investigation covers distinct stereochemical/pathway and conformational families and declares a scientifically justified stopping basis.
items.expected: The report identifies each hypothesis with its description, disposition and rationale; it quantifies generated, advanced and validated candidates, describes deduplication, and records a disposition rationale for each candidate family.

items.statement: The lowest validated R- and S-forming C–C pathways are compared on one separated-reactants free-energy reference.
items.expected: The report supplies pathway IDs, barriers, signed DeltaDeltaG and a consistent reference/temperature definition.

items.statement: The selectivity conclusion identifies C–C bond formation as the enantiodetermining event and discusses the subsequent rearomatization barrier comparison.
items.expected: The final conclusion links the R/S free-energy ordering to the selectivity-determining C–C event and states limitations.
